channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Joakim Noah | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Joakim Noah from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tony Parker on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Tony Parker:

“But if I have one regret in my career, it's that Joakim didn't play for the French national team more often, because unfortunately he had injuries that kept us from becoming Olympic champions. Because I'm convinced that if Jo hadn't gotten injured in 2012, I think we could have won a gold medal.”

Tony Parker on Joakim Noah, Oct 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah
item.description:
Anthony appeared on ESPN’s First Take in 2019 and revealed that he was close to joining Bulls in 2014 before deciding to return to New York.

“I was going to Chicago. Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah. I was there, right? I was there. And then I started getting whispers behind the scenes. ‘Yo, look, this person ain’t gonna be there. It ain’t really right. This and that.’ And it was all of that started to come up in the midst of my decision-making. I wasn’t going to let anything cloud that,”

Carmelo Anthony on Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah, May 20, 2023. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Joakim Noah
item.description:
KC Johnson:Derrick Rose on Joakim Noah:

“Everything that he gave to this franchise, the way he gave his all to the game, it means a lot. I’m happy to be here the night they’re celebrating him.”

Derrick Rose on Joakim Noah, Oct 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Joakim Noah, Michael Reinsdorf
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thibodeau on Noah:

“I’m just thrilled that Jerry and Michael (Reinsdorf) are recognizing him for what he did. And it’s great to see Joakim’s mother and father, his family. And just seeing where he is. He’s totally at peace. And he should be. He gave everything he had to the game”

Tom Thibodeau on Joakim Noah, Michael Reinsdorf, Oct 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Tom Thibodeau on Joakim Noah's retirement:

“I'm thrilled for him ... he was just an amazing teammate, and a winner. His career speaks for itself.”

Tom Thibodeau on Joakim Noah, Dec 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Bill Duffy on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Bill Duffy on Noah:

“What an illustrious career for Joakim, starting with two national titles at the University of Florida, to becoming an NBA Defensive Player of the Yearand ultimately evolving into one of the most passionate, spirited players to ever come through our sport. It’s been my honor to represent Joakim through his journey.”

Bill Duffy on Joakim Noah, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @wojespn.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Doc Rivers on Joakim Noah:

“I don’t know yet. He’s just a great veteran to have on the team. He’s been through the wars. He has the ability to give energy. He’s a phenomenal passer. A great talker on defense. But he hasn’t played in a year — or in a while. And so we’ll see.”

Doc Rivers on Joakim Noah, Mar 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Terrell Owens on Joakim Noah
item.description:
“That’s not the most desirable place to play football, but I didn’t allow that environment or what people said about it to deter me from going there.[Noah] might have a chance to go to Detroit, which isn’t a desirable destination, but I said be a bright spot in a not so great environment. It doesn’t matter. Just rededicate yourself and be the best basketball player you can be.”

Terrell Owens on Joakim Noah, Aug 6, 2019. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Mike Conley on Joakim Noah
item.description:
point guard Mike Conley said.

“Joakim is one of those guys that fits our system, fits the way we play, our mentality. He embodies everything that grit and grind means and stands for. We’re happy to have him.”

Mike Conley on Joakim Noah, Dec 5, 2018. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Marc Gasol on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Gasol:

“Noah will give us experience, physical play, capability as a passer and creator, and another voice in the locker room. He's the type of player that will adapt perfectly to our team. He plays with a lot of intensity, with a lot of passion and he places a lot of emphasis on defense. I liked [the signing] a lot. He knows how to make players around him better.”

Marc Gasol on Joakim Noah, Dec 1, 2018. Source: Basket-Infos.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Paul Pierce:

“I wouldn't be surprised if [Joakim] Noah ends up there [Timberwolves] this year also. That would be an odd situation. That'd be kind of weird.”

Paul Pierce on Joakim Noah, Sep 12, 2018. Source: reddit.

item.title: Al Horford on Joakim Noah, Billy Donovan
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Horford on pushing the ball in transition:

“At Florida coach Donovan would let us do that. Joakim and I would break the press – he always gave us that freedom. In high school my coach hated it. He was one of those old school coaches. No big should handle the ball.”

Al Horford on Joakim Noah, Billy Donovan, Dec 2, 2017. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Erik Horne:Donovan on former UF player Joakim Noah:

“I know he was frustrated with the fact he couldn’t help his team.”

Billy Donovan on Joakim Noah, Oct 19, 2017. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Jimmy Butler on friction with Rose/Noah:

“I don’t think everybody was on the same page, truthfully, for what guys’ roles was going to be.”

Jimmy Butler on Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah, Nov 4, 2016. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Funny line from Carmelo Anthony on Joakim Noah pushing the ball up the court, which happened several times Saturday:

“It was good to have him lead the break. He's been doing that all his career. We're going to limit him. We'll give him four or five push up the courts and after that we're going to cut it off.”

Carmelo Anthony on Joakim Noah, Oct 30, 2016. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Phil Jackson, Joakim Noah
item.description:
Rose said he maintained a workout regimen while on trial in L.A., and was eased mentally by the support from the Knicks.

“I was talking to them along the way, every day, talking to if not Phil (Jackson), Steve (Mills), Joakim, some of the other players that reached out,”

Derrick Rose on Phil Jackson, Joakim Noah, Oct 22, 2016. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Reinsdorf said of Rose's trade.

“We felt Joakim wasn't going to be a frontline guy anymore. I was pretty confident that Pau (Gasol) was going to leave. So it was important for us to get the center in (Robin) Lopez. It was time for Derrick to go on and play someplace else and try to establish himself. Gar and Pax were high on the Grant kid (Jerian). We thought that was the necessary first step no matter how we were going to go.”

Jerry Reinsdorf on Joakim Noah, Sep 13, 2016. Source: Chicago Tribune.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah
item.description:
K.C. Johnson:Reinsdorf on end of Rose/Noah, era:

“It's disappointing because I had high hopes for group. All the injuries to Derrick were disappointing.”

Jerry Reinsdorf on Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah, Sep 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Courtney Lee on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Lee:

“Before free agency, I was talking with Noah and it’s great seeing how passionate he is. This offseason, he’s getting out of breath just being on the phone – like he’s running sprints – but it’s because he’s talking about the city, talking about the fans,talking about the team and talking about everything we can accomplish together. He’s excited and he was recruiting me pretty much the entire time, telling me that I was the missing piece and what not. He kept telling me, ‘Let’s get it done!’ Noah was in my ear a lot.”

Courtney Lee on Joakim Noah, Jul 7, 2016. Source: Basketball Insiders.

item.title: John Paxson on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Paxson on Noah:

“Jo’s an unrestricted free agent, as is Pau. We’ve got several of those on our roster. A lot of that, this is up to them. We are going to sit down with Jo obviously, his agent, and talk and see. Anyone who has been around us, anybody who has spoken to either Gar or I about Joakim, they know how we feel about him. He represents a lot of things that we believe in. To me, he’s one of the most genuine people I’ve ever been around in this business, as far as people go. So we have an affinity for Jo. But we’ve got to talk, we’ve got to see where it goes.”

John Paxson on Joakim Noah, Apr 14, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Donovan on his former player and current Bull Joakim Noah:

“A lot of people see the floppy hair and the chest-bumping and the passion, but I don't think people a lot of times get to see him in a locker room. He's one of the greatest teammates that I've ever had a chance to coach.”

Billy Donovan on Joakim Noah, Nov 6, 2015. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Nick Friedell:Derrick Rose on seeing Joakim Noah coming off the bench:

“It's weird. It's a little weird, but he's a pro. He's been great about it. His spirit has been up besides getting hurt. His spirit's been up as far as competing, being himself and he knows how important he is to this team and everybody knows how important he is to this team.”

Derrick Rose on Joakim Noah, Oct 30, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Sam Smith:Hoiberg on Noah:

“He was great, energetic. Explosive and played with great swagger. That’s how Joakim is.”

Fred Hoiberg on Joakim Noah, Sep 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @SamSmithHoops.

item.title: Tony Parker on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Tony Parker:

“If (Joakim Noah) wants to return (to the French National Team), it would be a pleasure. He's a good player and the good players, we take them! It's also true that now the team is competitive. We have good players in his position. Rudy Gobert and Joffrey Lauvergne did an incredible job at the European Championship.”

Tony Parker on Joakim Noah, Sep 24, 2015. Source: BeBasket.fr.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Joakim Noah
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thibodeau on Noah:

“It's just some tendinitis. This time of year, when something flares up like that, we're going to play it safe.”

Tom Thibodeau on Joakim Noah, Apr 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Marc Gasol on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Ronald Tillery:Gasol on Noah:

“He plays hard and with a passion and that’s something that I really respect. I’m a big fan.”

Marc Gasol on Joakim Noah, Apr 21, 2014. Source: Twitter @CAGrizBeat.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Nick Friedell:Thibs on Noah:

“The most important stat is measuring the winning. And that's what makes him special,that's what makes him who he is.”

Tom Thibodeau on Joakim Noah, Apr 10, 2014. Source: Twitter @NickFriedell.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on Carlos Boozer, Mike Dunleavy, Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah, Taj Gibson
item.description:
“We're not starting from scratch... We still have Noah and Derrick and (Mike) Dunleavy and Taj Gibson and (Carlos) Boozer.”

Jerry Reinsdorf on Carlos Boozer, Mike Dunleavy, Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah, Taj Gibson, Jan 28, 2014. Source: Twitter @stevekylerNBA.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Joakim Noah
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thibodeau on Noah's comments from Saturday:

“To me, that’s who he is. He’s an emotional guy. . . . And he’s playing great basketball.”

Tom Thibodeau on Joakim Noah, Jan 13, 2014. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Bill Duffy on Joakim Noah
item.description:
Bill Duffy:

“I am thrilled to welcome Joakim to the BDA Family. He is, without a doubt, the most complete center in the game today and off the court exemplifies the exact caliber of athlete and human being compatible with BDA’s ideals. Joakim’s commitment to philanthropic and humanitarian works is impressive and we look forward to working with him in his future endeavors.”

Bill Duffy on Joakim Noah, Apr 15, 2013. Source: BDA Sports.
